thread:
lucas: quick sync - EdgeStor (HW) + CloudBazaar (SI) want marketplace listing. Legal asked if firmware needs notarization or vendor-signed PDF is enough. Launch target 2024-05-30.
emily: security: notarization preferred for firmware, but vendor-signed PDF ok if partner provides reproducible build proof + signed commit hashes. Notarization adds ~7 days.
maria: timeline tight. we still need SOC2 (or bridge), pen report (passworded), firmware-attest.pdf, sbom.spdx.csv, reproducible-build.txt, questionnaire.md, remediation-tracker.csv. Partners should upload to s3://rw-marketplace-partner-ingest/{partner}/{listing}/ via presigned PUTs.
raj: EdgeStor will provide firmware-attest.pdf + reproducible-build.txt (git SHA + build env). Notarization = pending. We'll try to notarize but need to know deadline impact.
olivia: CloudBazaar: pen vendor = SecureProbe (secprobe@example.com). We'll ask them to include CVSS, test dates, and remit ticket IDs for fixes. Can raw findings be uploaded?
emily: yes. Raw findings to presigned S3 as a password-protected zip (password out-of-band). Public listing gets only redacted-summary.pdf. Security will validate raw.
ben: Ops q - which KMS alias for SSE-KMS and can metadata include build-hash?
maria: use alias/marketplace-ingest-prod. Include x-amz-meta-build-hash on objects; we will verify against reproducible-build.txt.
ingest-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/partner-ingest-provenance (see firmware + provenance section).
maria: presign TTL - default 7 days but we can issue 3-day presigns if partner requests. Example upload:
```
curl -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --upload-file pen_report.zip
```
lucas: owners recap: CloudBazaar -> coordinate SI deliverables & redaction; EdgeStor -> firmware, SBOM, build provenance; Security -> verify raw + pen vendor chain-of-custody; Partnerships (maria) -> presigns + checklist + KMS alias.
maria: I'll generate presigned URLs and post them here once ready. Checklist I'll attach to the runbook and include required_files.txt.
olivia: we'll aim to deliver drafts: firmware + sbom by 2024-04-25, SOC draft 2024-04-26, pen draft 2024-04-28.
emily: vendors - include a questionnaire field "notarization_decision": {notarize_yes / notarize_no / pending} and CA contact if chosen.
raj: EdgeStor sets notarization_decision = pending for now.
lucas: OK scheduling a 30m checkpoint 2024-04-25 to confirm presigns and any notarization blockers. Thanks.
